update_config_hitl: update a Habitat config to enable HITL GUI control for KinematicHumanoid or SpotRobot agents
add_debug_third_person_camera: add a third person RGB debug camera sensor to the Habitat simulator config
validate_gui_controlled_agent: validate that a GUI controlled agent index is valid and agent type is supported
clear_gui_agent_sensors: clear camera sensors and remove lab sensors and measurements for GUI controlled agents
replace_actions_with_humanoidjoint: replace all task actions with HumanoidJointActionConfig for GUI controlled KinematicHumanoid agents
